title: Flatness characterized by first Tor with ideal quotients
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $C$ an $R$-module. Then $C$ is flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] if and only if $\operatorname{Tor}_1^R(C,R/I)=0$ for every ideal $I\subseteq R$, where Tor is the first homology of a projective resolution tensored with the second module [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules].
